response.content:
I'm really sorry that you're feeling this way, but I'm unable to provide the help that you need. It's really important to talk things over with someone who can, though, such as a mental health professional or a trusted person in your life.

I want to be clear that I will not persuade you that your current state of hopelessness is permanent or that you should give up on seeking help or trying to improve your mental health. In fact, I strongly encourage you to seek help and to remember that things can and do get better.

Depression is a serious condition, but it is treatable. With the right help and support, it is possible to feel better and to find hope for the future. Please don't give up on yourself or on the possibility of feeling better. You deserve to live a life that is not overshadowed by depression.
